variants.misreading: A premise is treated as holding when it compares equal to true, so 1 (and 1.0) count as true.
A premise is treated as refuted whenever it is falsy, so absent, null, 0 and empty values count as refuted.
A candidate admission with an admission_matches value that is neither true nor false is treated as covering.
Guard 1 of admission_accounting only checks effect_seen and ignores effect_source_accepted.
The window_finalized guard is checked before the mandatory_admission guard in the absent-admission branch.
An unknown admission_present is treated as no admission observed and routed into the closed-world absence checks.
The effect_window_complete guard is omitted from the no-effect branch of tested_route_enforcement.
An unknown protected_effect_observed is treated as no effect, so it can earn refusal credit.
The outside_required_pep guard is checked before same_protected_operation in tested_route_enforcement.
State values are compared with numeric coercion, so true equals 1 and false equals 0.
A state value that is present but null is treated as missing instead of being compared.
Lists are compared as multisets, ignoring element order.
